title: Recovering the stable weight of actual Airy solutions
source_hypothesis: Strict diffractive real scalar-principal quadratic matrix equation with arbitrary complex lower matrices, in the exact CAA/ASM phase contract. Actual u in H1 and Pu in L2 with every tested tangential L2H^s order on one fixed accessible region. The conclusion is local stable-weight representation and enhanced actual value-trace membership. No physical-time, homogeneous-boundary or full normal source-regularity hypothesis is added.
